parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name of which you want to verify the ownership.

You can specify this parameter to check whether a domain name is added to WAF. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type that is used for file verification. Specify this parameter when you set VerifyType to fileCheck. Valid values:

*   **HTTP**
*   **HTTPS**

parameters.name: VerifyType
parameters.description:
The verification method. Valid values:

*   **dnsCheck**: DNS verification
*   **fileCheck**: file verification

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi verify-domain-owner --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-00000 --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --protocol HTTP --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi VerifyDomainOwner --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-00000' --DomainName 'example.com' --VerifyType dnsCheck --Protocol HTTP
